reply_text:
Ruth, I can't set this up as a recurring job. I have no scheduler in this workspace, so I can't promise a post at 07:45 each morning, and I won't say it's set when it isn't.

The audience is fine. You, Gideon and Nadia are the members of #strategic-random, and all three of you are also in #strategic-pod and #inc-vtg-hartford, so a brief there wouldn't show anyone anything they can't already see.

I'll leave out money terms (rates, prices, contract values and so on) from the briefs, because finance figures can't go to a channel where others can read them. Operational facts like seat counts, dates and ticket numbers will be in.

Two ways to get the brief going:
- **Ask me each morning.** Ping me and I'll post the brief right then, covering everything since the last one.
- **Have someone with scheduler access add a 07:45 trigger** that calls me with this request.
